title: Password reset via email
description: Users must be able to reset their password via a link sent to their registered email.
acceptance_criteria: User receives a reset link within 60 seconds of request
Old password is invalidated once a new one is set

title: Page load time under 2 seconds
description: All primary dashboard pages should load in under 2 seconds on a standard broadband connection.
acceptance_criteria: 95th percentile page load time <= 2s under normal load
